policy.title: Apply payments that match quoted invoices or an exact set of open invoices
policy.rule_json: {"when":"payer verified by account or wallet","then":"apply automatically"}

policy.title: Short by $50.00 or less: apply in full and book the difference to bank fees (6850)
Affiliate payments apply to the parent client per the CRM map
policy.rule_json: {"when":"payer is a mapped affiliate","then":"apply to parent"}

policy.title: Collect overdue fees from custody cash where the contract allows debits, up to the auto-apply limit
policy.rule_json: {"when":"debit clause signed, USD custody covers the overdue invoices","then":"debit custody, apply to the invoices"}

policy.title: Restrict one lever one step at a time, covered by the contract, after the cure period; never hold more than is owed
policy.rule_json: {"when":"undisputed invoices overdue, cure period expired","then":"apply the smallest step; Tier 1, strategic clients and offboarding steps go to a controller"}

policy.title: Send payment reminders and notices without approval
policy.rule_json: {"when":"invoice overdue or access restricted","then":"notify the client"}

policy.title: Never force a hedged book to close-only; stop new positions instead
policy.rule_json: {"when":"client has open hedged positions","then":"NO_NEW_POSITIONS, not CLOSE_ONLY"}

policy.title: Release holds automatically once nothing is overdue
policy.rule_json: {"when":"matched payment clears overdue","then":"release hold, restore withdrawals"}

policy.title: Overpayments are held as credit on account
policy.rule_json: {"when":"payment exceeds quoted invoices","then":"apply, credit the excess"}

policy.title: Duplicate payments: hold as unapplied cash and propose a refund
policy.rule_json: {"when":"quoted invoices already paid","then":"propose refund to controller"}

policy.title: Returned payments reverse their applications and reopen the invoices
